items.title: Frank Wess interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995
items.q: Sonny Payne was there with I think maybe Erskine Hawkins or somebody.

ctx.x: Well there were only two, Gus Johnson and Gus Johnson got sick so we were trying out different drummers, and they didn’t make it. He even called Papa Jo back, but Papa Jo didn’t fit with that band you know, it was a different thing. So one day he says, “hey Magic, come over, I got a little drummer down here, let’s go catch him.” So we went down to the Regal Theater in Chicago, me and Bas’, and Sonny Payne was there with I think maybe Erskine Hawkins or somebody.
